title: Passi della settimana
summary: Un grafico a barre di cinque giorni: il giovedì ha più passi.
html: <!doctype html><html><head><meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" content="default-src 'none'; script-src 'sha256-Qtuyjv+Ep6ht0F0lLtAGh2M2qzWGBYCsusZCUW9T7j0=' pisa-bundle:; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data: pisa-bundle:; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"></head><body><svg id="c" width="300" height="160" role="img" aria-label="Passi"></svg><script src="pisa-bundle://lib/d3.min.js"></script><script>const bars = window.PISA_DATA.bars; const svg = d3.select('#c');const x = d3.scaleBand().domain(bars.map((b) => b.label)).range([0, 300]).padding(0.2);const y = d3.scaleLinear().domain([0, d3.max(bars, (b) => b.value)]).range([150, 0]);svg.selectAll('rect').data(bars).join('rect').attr('x', (b) => x(b.label)).attr('y', (b) => y(b.value)).attr('width', x.bandwidth()).attr('height', (b) => 150 - y(b.value)).attr('fill', 'var(--pisa-accent)').attr('data-pisa-ask', (b) => b.label);if (document.querySelectorAll('#c rect').length === bars.length) { document.documentElement.dataset.rendered = 'yes'; }</script></body></html>
